Welcome

The Golden Valley Kandy Hotel

Set on a quiet ridge above Kandy, The Golden Valley Kandy Hotel is dedicated to unhurried hospitality in the heart of Sri Lanka's hill country. Mist drifts through the valley each morning, tea plantations roll down the slopes, and every evening the gardens glow with lantern light.

Our team welcomes every guest in the traditional Sri Lankan way, with warmth, patience and genuine care, and gladly arranges temple visits, botanical garden walks and cultural evenings.

Around Kandy

Discover Kandy

Our team arranges drivers and guides to the best of the hill capital.

Temple of the Tooth

Sri Dalada Maligawa, the sacred heart of Kandy and a UNESCO World Heritage site.

Royal Botanical Gardens

Peradeniya's famous gardens with orchids, palm avenues and giant trees.

Kandy Lake

A calm evening walk around the lake beside the old royal palace.

Tea Plantations

Rolling green slopes, tea factory visits and fresh Ceylon tea tasting.

Cultural Evenings

Traditional Kandyan dance and drumming performances in the city.

Forest Walks

Peaceful nature trails through green hill country forest reserves.

Good to Know

Questions

How do I book a room?

Fill in the booking form at the top of the page and it opens a ready-made WhatsApp message to our team, who reply personally to confirm availability.

Is breakfast included?

Breakfast is included in the Deluxe Mountain View Room and the Kandyan Heritage Suite. The Standard Hillside Room has our restaurant on site.

Can you arrange tours and drivers?

Yes. We gladly arrange temple visits, botanical garden walks, tea country drives and cultural evenings. Just ask our team.

Is Wi-Fi free?

Yes, fast complimentary Wi-Fi is available in every room, the restaurant and the garden pavilions.

How can I contact the hotel?

Message us on WhatsApp at +94 74 413 6085 and we will reply personally.
